source_caption:
The scene where Sam finally reaches Molly through Oda Mae in Ghost works because Whoopi Goldberg becomes the emotional bridge between two people who can’t touch anymore. Patrick Swayze gives the moment its longing, Demi Moore gives it disbelief and heartbreak, but Goldberg grounds the impossible with warmth, humor, and tenderness.

Ghost (1990), directed by Jerry Zucker, starring Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg. A supernatural romance about love, grief, and connection beyond death, blending mystery, humor, and heartbreak into one of the most unforgettable films of the 1990s.

source_details.synopsis: Ghost is a 1990 American supernatural romance film directed by Jerry Zucker, written by Bruce Joel Rubin, and starring Patrick Swayze, Demi Moore, Whoopi Goldberg, and Tony Goldwyn. The film's plot follows Sam Wheat (Swayze), a banker who is murdered and returns as a ghost, unable to interact with the living world. With the help of psychic con artist Oda Mae Brown (Goldberg), Sam attempts to uncover those responsible for his murder and communicate with his girlfriend, Molly Jensen (Moore), who is unaware of his presence.
